question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (v).
solution:
The correct answer is '**pronounced**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the official declaration of death at a hospital.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate a formal announcement by medical personnel.
 
• "**Pronounced**" fits well as it conveys the medical confirmation of death.
 
• Other options ("**shot**", "**acting**", "**almost**") do not fit the context of an official medical declaration.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *On the afternoon of 30 March 1981, many Americans experienced a 1. feeling__ of déjà-vu. Déjà-vu is a name given to the feeling that a person has seen or experienced an event before. Many Americans could not help having that feeling on this day. The 2. __news__ hit TVs and radios immediately. President Ronald Reagan had been shot. He was leaving a hotel in Washington DC, turned to wave at some of the people gathered to see him, and fell towards the ground. Before he could hit the ground, his Secret Service Agents 3. __whisked__ him into the car and rushed to the nearest hospital. This same story had been heard before. On 22 November 1963 President John F Kennedy was riding in a motorcade through Dallas, Texas. He smiled and waved to the crowd that had gathered to see him. 4. __Shots__ rang out from a nearby building. The President collapsed into the backseat of the car and was immediately taken to the nearest hospital. He was 5. __pronounced__ dead at the hospital. Now, just seventeen years later, the news sounded eerily the same.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shot** (गोलियों): "Shot" describes the action or condition but doesn't fit as a posthumous declaration.
 
• **Acting** (अभिनय): "Acting" describes performing and is unrelated to the declaration of death.
 
• **Almost** (लगभग): "Almost" suggests something nearly happened, which is inappropriate for confirming death.
